accepted_probe_method: Real SendInput; IsIconic sampled immediately before and after the native vmctl command; exit 1, no PNG, explicit no-fresh-frame error.
unqualified_cua_trial: The earlier minimized.png/frame.json are excluded from minimized-window evidence. Cua reported a minimized window, but no immediate IsIconic sample bracketed that command. That command produced a WGC image, and the following bring_to_front reported restored=false. The atomic probe above removes this timing ambiguity.
restore: restored-direct.frame.json records capture after the accepted minimized probe. restored-motion.png/frame.json show a new Qt workload after restore.
recording: recording/audit.json validates thirteen distinct RGB frames with strictly advancing WGC ticks. GIF sampling is separate from application frame rate.
